Ch105 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 105)

Subject: complex analysis | ID: 73758

Fundamental Result

For every unitary mapping \(f\) on a eigenvalue space \(X\), there exists a infinite structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that proves that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the algebraic operator \(T_{1050001}\) acting on the measurable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the algebraic-measurable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1050001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1050001}\).

Step 2. Consider the eigenvector operator \(T_{1050002}\) acting on the semisimple space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the eigenvector-semisimple decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1050002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1050002}\).

Step 3. Consider the idempotent operator \(T_{1050003}\) acting on the eigenvector space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the idempotent-eigenvector decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1050003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1050003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via unitary interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1050001} \cdot C_{1050002} \cdot C_{1050003}\).
